title: 10 links that explain today's leverage whipsaw: a 2x Reddit fund isdown 72% in 30 days. A warning?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Daily-reset leverage cuts both ways. GraniteShares' 2x Reddit fund is  
down 72% in 30 days, while Tradr's 2x short Nebius fund is up 46% as  
Nebius sold off. Plus a 2x FANG+ note with a $165 target and the  
Tesla, Dow and volatility pairs. Here's today's look at how leverage  
is cutting both ways — which side are you on?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF (RDTL)\*\* — RDTL declined  
roughly 72% over the trailing 30 days, falling from about $12.89 to  
$3.60, as 2x daily leverage amplified a sharp selloff in Reddit  
shares.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/graniteshares-2x-long-rddt-daily-etf-rdtl-falls-72-over-30-days-as-reddit-volatility-hits-hard-39449/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/graniteshares-2x-long-rddt-daily-etf-rdtl-falls-72-over-30-days-as-reddit-volatility-hits-hard-39449/)  
  
\*\*2. Tradr 2X Short NBIS Daily ETF (NBIZ)\*\* — NBIZ climbed roughly 46%  
over the last 30 days, rising from $37.05 to a Nov 16, 2026 close of  
$54.23. The fund seeks daily results equal to two times the inverse  
(-200%) of Nebius Group's (NBIS) daily performance, so it gains when  
NBIS declines.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/tradr-2x-short-nbis-daily-etf-nbiz-advances-46-as-nebius-group-faces-pressure-39667/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/tradr-2x-short-nbis-daily-etf-nbiz-advances-46-as-nebius-group-faces-pressure-39667/)  
  
\*\*3. FNGO\*\* — The central target used here is $165 , roughly 28% above  
the ETN's recent price near $128.65, and it is tied to a technical  
milestone rather than an analyst consensus.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/fngo-can-the-2x-fang-etn-reach-165-for-a-potential-28-gain-39456/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/fngo-can-the-2x-fang-etn-reach-165-for-a-potential-28-gain-39456/)  
  
\*\*4. TSLL vs TSLZ\*\* — Comparing These Opposite 2x Tesla Leveraged  
ETFs. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/tsll-vs-tslz-comparing-these-opposite-2x-tesla-leveraged-etfs-39555/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/tsll-vs-tslz-comparing-these-opposite-2x-tesla-leveraged-etfs-39555/)  
  
\*\*5. SDOW vs UDOW\*\* — Weighing 3x Inverse and Long Exposure to the  
Dow. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sdow-vs-udow-weighing-3x-inverse-and-long-exposure-to-the-dow-39720/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sdow-vs-udow-weighing-3x-inverse-and-long-exposure-to-the-dow-39720/)  
  
\*\*6. VXZ vs XXV\*\* — Weighing Medium-Term Volatility Exposure Against  
Its Inverse. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead?  
The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/vxz-vs-xxv-weighing-medium-term-volatility-exposure-against-its-inverse-39736/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/vxz-vs-xxv-weighing-medium-term-volatility-exposure-against-its-inverse-39736/)  
  
\*\*7. GDXU vs UGL\*\* — Weighing 3x Gold Miners Leverage Against 2x  
Bullion Exposure. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out  
ahead? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/gdxu-vs-ugl-weighing-3x-gold-miners-leverage-against-2x-bullion-exposure-39727/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/gdxu-vs-ugl-weighing-3x-gold-miners-leverage-against-2x-bullion-exposure-39727/)  
  
\*\*8. MSFU\*\* — MSFU is the Direxion Daily MSFT Bull 2X Shares, a  
leveraged exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks daily investment  
results equal to 200% of the daily performance of Microsoft  
Corporation (MSFT) common stock.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/msfu-a-leveraged-etf-for-daily-exposure-to-microsoft-39693/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/msfu-a-leveraged-etf-for-daily-exposure-to-microsoft-39693/)  
  
\*\*9. CONL\*\* — CONL is the GraniteShares 2x Long COIN Daily ETF, a  
leveraged single-stock ETF that seeks 200% of the daily return of  
Coinbase Global, Inc. stock.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/conl-examining-the-2x-leveraged-coinbase-etf-39686/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/conl-examining-the-2x-leveraged-coinbase-etf-39686/)  
  
\*\*10. QB\*\* — QB is the ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dynamic Daily Buffer ETF,  
a fund that seeks to track the Nasdaq-100 while applying a daily-reset  
buffer and cap strategy.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/qb-proshares-nasdaq-100-dynamic-daily-buffer-etf-down-6-1-amid-broader-tech-pullback-39654/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/qb-proshares-nasdaq-100-dynamic-daily-buffer-etf-down-6-1-amid-broader-tech-pullback-39654/)  
  
Is a 72% drawdown in 30 days just leverage doing leverage things, or a warning?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
